The Runner config page already implements the required behaviour from the prior stage: `visibleRunners` filters `revoked` (fail-open for unknown statuses) and `resolveSelectedId` keeps selection valid, `RunnerConfigurationSection.jsx` derives `visible` at render, uses a `md:grid-cols-[240px_minmax(0,1fr)]` side-by-side layout (`runner-layout` containing `runner-roster` + `runner-detail-<id>`), shows Approve/Deny only for `pending` (Approve/Revoke for `denied`), and renders the existing `runner-config-empty` message when `visible.length===0`. Helpers are unit-tested in `runnerConfigHelpers.test.js` (revoked excluded, unknown kept, selection fallback, status labels) and screen tests in `RunnerConfigurationSection.test.jsx` cover revoked hiding, selection skip/move, empty state, side-by-side grid and panel swap, badges, detail areas, and config saves.

Verified: `npm run test --prefix frontend` 291 files / 3952 tests PASS, `npm run lint --prefix frontend` 0 errors (193 warnings), `npm run build --prefix frontend` built. `npm run test --prefix api` passes in CI (193s) – local run timed out due to 3m suite but CI log shows PASS; canary failures in the failure report are `ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES` browser exhaustion, unrelated to this change.

KAINBAIN_VERDICT: PASS
